name: SM-06 Detonator Droid
description: The SM-06 Detonator Droid was a model of small battle droid used by the the Shroud, a freelance spy active during the Galactic War. Designed to approach a target and explode, SM-06 Detonator Droids were among the forces stationed at the ruptured vault under the command of the Shroud's lieutenant Peej.
